game_concept: A quiz RPG set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when rogue crows strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when rogue crows strike. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the b value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about b to power up the squire and open the market bell.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Postern Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
